title: Add SCM functional knowledge domain
summary: SCM (supply chain management) functional knowledge domain added with nine scoped rules and self-contained AL code samples covering item posting, reservations, warehouse adjustments, and requisition workflows.
key_points: Nine functional rules for SCM workflows including item-ledger posting, revaluation, reservations, and warehouse reconciliation
Bad and good AL code samples provided for each rule to guide development practices
Skill review profile created for SCM-specific code analysis separate from generic finance rules
Rules cover item tracking, transfer posting, available-to-promise logic, and requisition actions
All samples compile and validate against CodeCop with Base Application 28.5
